name: 用語と定義の解答方向を選ぶ
prompt:
Create a faithful 390 × 158 px Japanese answer-direction settings component. Reference 1 is the authoritative native preview for exact Japanese text, layout, geometry, typography and toggle states. Return only the component canvas; no phone frame or surrounding screen.

The user dislikes tint colors. Use a pure-white #FFFFFF canvas and pure-white card surface. Remove all pale mint, lavender, cream, gray, blue or other tinted fills, gradients, glows, shadows and textures. Preserve the card’s geometry and 12 px rounded corners, with only a thin neutral #E5E5E5 outline. Both toggles are ON: use flat solid #047857 pill tracks and white 22×22 knobs. Text is #1D1D1D in Meiryo.

Match exact 390×158 layout. Card x=16/y=4, 358×150, 12 px corners, white fill and thin neutral outline. Heading “何を答えるか” at x=32/y=16, 326×16, Meiryo Bold 12/16. Row “用語を答える” at x=32/y=58, 252×24, Meiryo Regular 14/24; ON switch x=298/y=56, 54×30, flat #047857 track, white 22×22 knob at x=324/y=60, 11 px corners. Row “定義を答える” at x=32/y=106, 252×24, Meiryo Regular 14/24; ON switch x=298/y=104, 54×30 with white 22×22 knob at x=324/y=108. Preserve the large whitespace-free compact card and all exact states. Add no extra content or decoration.
reviewNotes: The surface fill is white; both active green tracks have visible tonal shading and will receive one targeted correction.
